## Telegram Server Monitor Bot

Every 10 min → check server health via HTTP → parse CPU/RAM/disk → alert if critical → log to Sheets.

**Setup:**
1. Edit Server List with your server endpoints (must expose /api/health)
2. Set Telegram Bot credentials and chat ID
3. Create Google Sheet: serverName, host, cpu, ram, disk, uptime, isCritical, status, timestamp, date
4. Adjust thresholds in Parse Server Stats (default: CPU>90%, RAM>85%, Disk>90%)
